sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美美元金融中枢、私人利益基金会（PIF）与运河船舶登记

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Marine Fuel Bunkering and Lubricant Replenishment

stage_1.expense_line_item: Certificado de búsqueda y reserva de nombre (name search and reservation certificate)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 32 de 26 de febrero de 1927 (General Corporation Law), as amended by Ley 5 de 16 de enero de 2019, particularly Articles 1-12 (incorporation by Escritura Pública), Article 18 (authorized capital), Article 40 (directors' powers), Article 54 (registered office and Resident Agent), and Article 62 (shareholder records); supplementary application of Código de Comercio Article 5 and Executive Decree No. 23 de 2014 on electronic filings.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección del Registro Mercantil (Mercantile Section of the Public Registry of Panama)
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Escritura Pública de Constitución (Public Deed of Incorporation) embodying the Pacto Social and Estatutos, requiring inscription (asiento) in the Mercantile Section
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Standard articles authorize nominal capital of USD 10,000 represented by 10,000 common shares of USD 1.00 par value each; shares may be subscribed without disbursement, no escrow or blocked corporate account is required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED FIRST: that the subscription of one hundred (100) Ordinary Class A Shares, as set forth in the Escritura Pública de Constitución dated [DATE], be and the same is hereby ratified and accepted as fully paid; no further paid-up capital being required under Panamanian law. RESOLVED SECOND: that the registered office of the Company shall be fixed at [REGISTERED OFFICE ADDRESS], Panama, and that [RESIDENT AGENT NAME], attorney, be and is hereby retained as Resident Agent of the Company. RESOLVED THIRD: that [NAME] be appointed President, [NAME] Secretary and [NAME] Treasurer, each to serve until successors are elected; and the President is hereby authorized to execute banking forms, tax filings and bunkering license applications on behalf of the Company.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Name Registration Office (Ventanilla de Certificados de Registro de Nombre / online portal for authorized attorneys)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit one to three proposed corporate names in decreasing order of preference through the authorized attorney's online account or at the physical window. The Registry conducts an exact and phonetically/confusably similar search; upon approval and payment of the prescribed fee, the Certificado de Registro de Nombre is issued, valid for 30 business days and renewable for equal consecutive periods. The certificate must be attached to the subsequent incorporation deed.
required_dossiers: Completed Solicitud de Registro de Nombre application form
Passport or identity card of the applicant or incorporating attorney
Filing power of attorney, if submission is made by an authorized representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected due to prior identical or confusingly similar registration, the attorney files a new application with alternative names; an administrative objection may be lodged against a conflicting registration within the legal term, and in the event of ministerial refusal the applicant may invoke the reconsideration appeal before the Directorate General of the Registro Público within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Notarization of the Public Deed of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública de la República de Panamá (any licensed Panamanian notary under the rotary notarial system)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Corporate counsel drafts the Escritura Pública de Constitución containing the Pacto Social and Estatutos, including the corporate name, registered office, Resident Agent appointment, object clause covering offshore marine fuel bunkering and lubricant replenishment, authorized capital, subscriber details, board provisions and the term/dissolution clauses. The deed is read before the notary, executed by the incorporators and two attesting witnesses, and the notary issues the primer testimonio (first extract) for filing and registration with the Public Registry.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Registro de Nombre (valid name reservation certificate)
Passport or identity documents of each shareholder, director and officer
AML/KYC due diligence declarations under Law 23 of 2015 and its regulatory decree
Certified Spanish translation of any foreign-language document
Resident Agent acceptance letter executed by a licensed Panamanian attorney or law firm
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary or drafting counsel identifies legal defects such as unlawful object clauses, insufficient capital description, or missing mandatory statutory provisions, the deed is redrafted and re-executed before execution; if the notarial protocol is delayed, an identical deed may be executed before another notary upon recovery of the original draft, without prejudice to notarial liability for unreasonable delay.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Inscription in the Mercantile Section of the Public Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registro Público de Panamá — Sección del Registro Mercantil (Mercantile Section)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the primer testimonio of the Escritura Pública de Constitución, the original name reservation certificate, the Resident Agent acceptance letter, and the fee payment receipt electronically through the authorized attorney portal or physically at the registry counter. The Registrador Mercantil verifies statutory compliance, orders the inscription asiento, and issues the Certificado de Inscripción and the Persona Jurídica certificate, which evidences the legal existence and distinct personality of the Sociedad Anónima.
required_dossiers: Primer testimonio (first extract) of the Escritura Pública de Constitución
Original Certificado de Registro de Nombre
Resident Agent acceptance letter (Carta de Aceptación del Agente Residente)
Proof of payment of inscription fees (derechos de inscripción)
If required, Form 2152 / supplementary registry questionnaire
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrador issues an advertencia (defect notice), the incorporating attorney corrects the noted deficiency by presenting a supplementary aclaración deed or additional evidence within the ten-day cure term; a final refusal may be challenged through the recurso de apelación before the Director General of the Registro Público within 10 business days, after which judicial recourse before the Third Chamber of the Supreme Court remains available.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección General de Ingresos (DGI) of the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas (MEF), Unitary National authority without sub-national income-tax agencies; official portal: dgi.mef.gob.pa; transactional e-file and e-invoicing platform: Sistema de Gestión Fiscal (SGF) at sgf.mef.gob.pa.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A non-resident-owned Panamanian Sociedad Anónima (S.A.) conducting ship bunkering and refueling at Panamanian ports obtains its TIN as follows: (1) notarial incorporation and inscription of the Escritura Pública in the Registro Público de Panamá, with a licensed resident agent and capital declaration; (2) filing of the RUC (Registro Único de Contribuyente) application with the DGI via the SGF online portal, attaching the certified corporate charter, resident-agent acceptance, and the beneficial-ownership report required under Ley 129 de 2020; (3) issuance of the RUC certificate with simultaneous ITBMS taxpayer registration; (4) procurement of the municipal Aviso de Operación from the relevant port municipality and of sectoral permits, namely the AMP bunkering licence (Autoridad Marítima de Panamá), the fuel-trading licence of the Secretaría Nacional de Energía, and the exporter registration at the customs single window (VUCE/ANA) for electronic export declarations; (5) activation of the DGI electronic-invoice credential. Non-resident shareholders may remain shielded in standard S.A. filings, but must be disclosed in the restricted beneficial-ownership register filed at the DGI.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists in Panama. Available statutory elections relevant to this bunkering S.A. include: (i) the exporter ITBMS export-credit refund election permitting recovery of input VAT attributable to zero-rated exports; (ii) the optional tonnage/flag tax settlement for vessels owned by the S.A. where it qualifies as an international shipping enterprise under Panamanian registration law; (iii) the small-taxpayer (Pequeño Contribuyente / simplified SME) regime election while annual taxable turnover remains below B/242,000; (iv) special investment-zone stabilization elections (for example Panamá Pacífico or Colon Free Zone regimes) fixing ITBMS at zero on exported bunkering supplies; and (v) source-classification elections under the territorial sourcing rules of the Código Fiscal (Article 694 et seq.) to segregate Panamanian-source income from foreign-source freight and supply income. Hybrid-mismatch rules are not separately codified; Panama follows its BEPS MLI positions at treaty level, with no domestic anti-hybrid check-the-box election available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_cost_currency: B/. (Balboa, US Dollar pegged at 1:1); no DGI statutory fee for RUC issuance, but notarial, registry, municipal Aviso de Operación, and sectoral licence costs apply separately
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.annual_compliance_calendar: ISR annual declaration by 31 March following the fiscal year (excess ITBMS refund claims quarterly); monthly ITBMS declaration and payment by the 15th of the following month; transfer-price informational filing (when cross-border related-party transactions exceed B/1,000,000) by 30 September; FO-7A form for shareholders' dividend distribution within statutory deadlines.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: ITBMS (Impuesto de Transferencia de Bienes Muebles y Servicios) — Panamanian VAT-type transfer tax governed by Ley 6 de 2016 and the Código Fiscal
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: None, expressed in Balboas (B/., pegged at 1:1 to the US Dollar); any continuous commercial transfer of movable goods or provision of services occurring in Panamanian territory obliges ITBMS registration from the first taxable transaction; no general de-minimis threshold applies to incorporated enterprises, although occasional non-resident suppliers may be required to register only to document a single taxable transaction.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory under the phased DGI rollout completed in 2023: every ITBMS taxpayer, including bunkering exporters, must issue electronic invoices through the SGF Facturación Electrónica platform, obtain a DGI authorization code and a digital stamp (QR 'sello digital') before delivering the invoice, and transmit dataset files to the DGI web-services API (REST/SOAP with X.509 digital credentials) within 24 hours of issuance; export invoices must cite the ANA customs DUA reference. The fiscal-printer regime is limited to simplified small taxpayers. Zero-rated export transactions are subject to the same e-invoicing clearance before the related customs export is released.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating at 0% ITBMS applies under Ley 6 de 2016 where marine gas oil (MDO), heavy fuel oil (IFO 380), marine gasoline, and lubricants are transferred (a) to vessels engaged in international navigation on a foreign-bound voyage (domestic cabotage and coastal fishing excluded); (b) at a Panamanian port, anchorage, or bonded fuel terminal; (c) against a bunkering order issued by a non-resident shipowner, charterer, or managing agent; and (d) physically delivered under a Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) with customs-supervised export movement. The supplier must hold a valid AMP bunkering licence and the customs export documentation must evidence the next foreign port of destination; otherwise the supply is reclassified as a taxable domestic delivery at 7%.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (DUA) filed electronically through the ANA SIDUNEA system and the VUCE single window
Bunker Delivery Note (BDN) signed by the vessel's Chief Engineer and endorsed by the local shipping agent
Bill of Lading, ship's manifest, or port clearance (Zarpe) evidencing the international destination of the voyage
Inward Remittance Certificate issued by an authorized Panamanian bank (or equivalent foreign-bank remittance evidence) proving collection from the non-resident buyer
Commercial invoice and bunker supply contract identifying the non-resident buyer and the international-voyage condition
Tank/hose-meter calibration receipts and weight-survey certificate evidencing delivered metric tons
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Unsubstantiated or fraudulent zero-rating is treated by the DGI as a taxable domestic supply: the DGI assesses the 7% ITBMS, reverses any export-credit refund already allowed, applies a monthly surcharge (recargo) of 1% up to 100% of the tax, and imposes fines scaled under Ley 6 de 2016 and the Código Fiscal between 10% and 200% of the evaded tax for repeated or concealment-related offenses. Forged BDN or DUA documents trigger criminal tax-fraud prosecution with imprisonment of up to 8 years under Panama's tax and anti-money-laundering fraud provisions, confiscation of the fuel or proceeds, revocation of the AMP bunkering permit, and publication of the sanction. Refunds recovered are immediately repayable with the same accruals running from the refund payment date.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of Panama does not maintain a central bank; the US dollar is legal tender and the monetary system is dollarized. Banking supervision is vested in the Superintendencia de Bancos de Panamá (SBP), which licenses banks, exchange houses, and other financial intermediaries. No state exchange-control commission or foreign-exchange administration exists; external financing and consolidated fiscal monitoring are handled by the Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Panama permits full and unrestricted convertibility on both current and capital account transactions. Because the US dollar is the domestic currency, no exchange authorization, central bank return, or conversion spread is required. Profit remittances and dividend distributions may be freely executed through SBP-licensed banks; the de facto hurdles are exclusively bank-level AML/KYC due-diligence, documentary evidence of source of funds, and confirmation that the Panamanian entity is in good standing and holds a certificate of foreign tax residency if treaty relief is sought. There are no capital controls, no repatriation limits, and no statutory withholding or surrender obligations on profit remittances.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: None. Panama does not require mandatory surrender, repurchase, repatriation, or conversion of export proceeds. Bunker export proceeds and other foreign receivable collections may be retained abroad or brought into Panama in USD without restriction. However, for accounting and tax territoriality purposes, the treasury should segregate invoices, vessel delivery logs, and remittance advices to substantiate the offshore or onshore sourcing of each transaction.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-Low. Panama does not have an EU-style electronic-money institution (EMI) licensing regime; e-money activities are absorbed by the banking licence framework supervised by the SBP. Offshore digital EMIs may provide ancillary USD-denominated wallets, dual-currency cards, or payment aggregation, but they cannot lawfully serve as the primary operative treasury, capital escrow, or trade settlement account for a Panamanian Sociedad Anónima engaged in ship bunkering. Legal and compliance risk is material; EMIs should be restricted to operational niceties and never used for AML-critical escrow flows.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: At least one natural-person director or senior signatory is normally required to attend an in-person KYC interview at a Panamanian bank branch, or before a Panama notary or Panamanian consular officer for remote-facilitated openings. Pure remote opening without physical appearance is generally not available for top-tier banks when the entity operates in a Medium-Risk Enhanced sector such as marine fuel bunkering. Banks will also require the original certificate of incorporation, registered articles, proof of the fiduciary ownership structure, and legalized or apostilled documents issued within ninety days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Presence of bearer shares, nominee directors, or a private interest foundation (PIF) in the beneficial-ownership chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Rendered owner register with full name, date of birth, nationality, passport copies, current residential address, and source of wealth; apostilled foundation council resolution confirming the ultimate beneficial owner; authenticated corporate certificate with bearer-share conversion evidence; sworn compliance affidavit; and a written undertaking to notify the bank of any ownership changes within 15 days.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Exposure to sanctioned flags, vessels, or end-customers in high-risk jurisdictions during bunker deliveries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fleet list with unique IMO numbers; certificate of flag registry; vessel oil pollution insurance (P&I) cover; OFAC, UN, EU, and UK sanctions-screening reports for all charterers and receiving vessels; denial-list search results; voyage clearance from competent maritime authority; and contractual warranties confirming no diversion to sanctioned territories.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unusual payment routing, third-party payors, or split disbursements inconsistent with bunker bill amounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed bunker sales contract; marine fuel delivery note (MFDN) and barge/terminal receipt; quantity and quality survey report; bill of lading or barge delivery confirmation; invoice history with agreed wire reference; KYC file on every non-vessel counterparty; notarized debt-assignment instrument if a payment factor or receivable financing vehicle is used; and confirmation that funds came from a named bank account, never from cash or anonymous sources.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Shareholder capital injections should be transferred in USD using the standard SWIFT MT103 message through an SBP-licensed Panamanian bank. The remitter must state the beneficiary as the Panamanian S.A. with its exact account number and SWIFT/BIC, reference the corporate business name exactly as registered, and include the payment narrative 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION — SOCIEDAD ANÓNIMA'. Supporting documents should include a certified board resolution authorizing the capital increase, an updated shareholder register, and a source-of-funds statement. Since Panama is dollarized, the receiving bank will credit USD directly with no conversion or exchange-control paperwork. Where the parent or shareholder is foreign, the remittance should be labelled as 'direct investment' and, where applicable, reported internally for transfer-pricing and economic-substance documentation.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade disbursements for bunker fuel procurement, lubricant replenishment, and port-service settlements should be executed using direct SWIFT MT103 credits for ordinary invoices and standby letters of credit (SBLC) or commercial documentary letters of credit issued under UCP600 for deferred or documentary shipments. The LC chain will normally include an MT700/MT707 issuance and amendment series requiring presentation of marine fuel delivery notes, quantity and quality certificates, invoices, statement of facts, and discharge port vouchers. Because Panama is a USD clearing centre, USD transfers are settled via US correspondent banks, typically through Fedwire or CHIPS, adding a one-to-two business day clearing cycle. Treasury must enforce one unique payment reference per bunker delivery and prohibit third-party cash settlements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable foreign exchange forwards against the US dollar with licensed Panamanian banks or global counterparties, primarily for Euro, Pound Sterling, and Chinese Renminbi-denominated bunker supplier contracts.

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) for Latin American and other restricted-convertibility currencies such as Argentine Peso, Chilean Peso, Colombian Peso, Brazilian Real, and Peruvian Sol where local convertibility is limited.
Cross-currency swaps between USD and EUR, GBP, or CNH for long-horizon liquidity matching against multi-currency marine fuel procurement and sale contracts.
Vanilla currency options and option collar structures for managing optional but uncertain vessel itinerary FX exposures in major trade hub currencies.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Panama Public Registry (Registro Público de Panamá)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation plus 90 calendar days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of US$50 for first 2 months; US$100 thereafter; continued non-payment for 5 years leads to strike-off from the Public Registry

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Income Tax Return (Declaración Anual de Renta)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Panama General Directorate of Revenue (DGI - Dirección General de Ingresos)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year end; 31 March for calendar-year entities
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 10% of tax due, minimum US$100 per unfiled period; interest accrual; possible administrative suspension

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGI Beneficial Owners Registry (Registro de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on the company's incorporation anniversary; supplementary filing within 30 days of shareholding or control change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines up to US$1,000 for late or false filing; cancellation of good standing certificate

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory audit only for Panama-domiciled operations generating Panama-source revenue exceeding US$1,000,000 annually or for publicly-traded entities; off-shore S.A. without Panama economic activity is exempt from independent statutory audit
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Panamanian Accounting Plan (Plan General de Contabilidad) for local activities; IFRS for financial, insurance, and other supervised industry entities

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Beneficial ownership must be reconfirmed through DGI's electronic registry each year on the anniversary of incorporation. Any transfer of a shareholding or change of control requires an update within 30 days, including identification of every individual holding directly or indirectly more than 10% of shares or exercising decision-making control.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$1,800–US$3,500 if audit is required; nil for fully off-shore S.A.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% flat corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta, ISR) on net taxable income derived from Panamanian-source activities; a 1% alternative minimum tax on gross taxable revenue (Tasa Única) applies where it exceeds the ordinary ISR liability.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Panama applies a territorial-scope system. Profits from foreign-source activities are excluded from Panamanian taxable income even when received by a Panamanian-domiciled Sociedad Anónima. Bunkering revenue derived from the supply of marine fuels and lubricants to foreign-flag vessels in international transit, negotiated, invoiced, and economically managed outside Panama's domestic market, is treated as foreign-source and effectively exempt from corporate income tax. No capital duty, no wealth tax, and no branch equalization charge apply. The SEM (Multinational Headquarters) regime, Panama Pacifico special economic zone, and the exemption for international shipping income of Panamanian-flag operators further reduce effective taxation to zero on qualifying offshore earnings.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 101 (Declaración de Renta - Impuesto sobre la Renta); filed electronically through the DGI 'T@-C' online platform with digital signature authorization.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual ISR return must be filed within three months after the fiscal year-end; calendar-year companies must file no later than March 15 of the following tax year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income from Panamanian-source activities (ventas y servicios de fuente panameña).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter only income effectively attributable to Panamanian-source operations; foreign-source offshore bunkering contracts, delivery fees, and charter-related revenues are excluded and reconciled on the informative annex.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible costs and expenses directly related to Panamanian-source income (marine fuel procurement, terminal storage, port charges, crew-related costs, depreciation).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Claim only documented expenses allocable to Panamanian-source earnings; do not net foreign-source costs against Panamanian-source receipts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net taxable income (renta neta gravable) after statutory deductions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign-source taxable losses may not reduce Panamanian-source net income; maintain a full split-accounting ledger between domestic and foreign-source profit pools.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income tax computed at 25% on the net taxable income shown in Box 3.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the company qualifies for the foreign-source exemption, the Box 4 liability should be nil except for any small residual Panamanian-source profit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tasa Única comparativa: 1% alternative tax on gross taxable revenue, applied if higher than the ordinary Box 4 tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bunkering operations typically produce high gross revenue with thin margins; the Tasa Única often exceeds the normal ISR. Verify whether foreign-source gross receipts are excludable from the Tasa Única base before computing the minimum tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Creditable advance payments (pagos trimestrales), withheld taxes, and prior-year carry-forwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Attach quarterly prepayment receipts and all third-party withholding certificates; overpayments may be carried forward or credited, but refunds are slow and trigger DGI audit scrutiny.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing attracts a fine ranging from USD 50 to USD 500, increased to up to 10% of the tax due where a balance is owed. Late payment accrues a monthly surcharge of 1.5% on the unpaid principal plus statutory delinquency interest enforceable by asset seizure. Fraudulent or persistent non-filing is prosecuted as criminal tax evasion with fines of 100%-300% of the evaded tax and imprisonment of up to five years.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 101-P (Pagos Trimestrales a Cuenta) - quarterly estimated income tax advance declarations remitted through the DGI T@-C portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly installments are due within 15 days after each quarter-end: April 15, July 15, October 15, and January 15.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimate of taxable Panamanian-source net income for the current quarter.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude all foreign-source bunkering earnings from the estimate; the DGI expects coherent quarterly estimates matching the annual Form 101 allocation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Advance payment amount (25% of the estimated annual tax allocated quarterly).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Failure to pay adequate quarterly installments triggers interest acceleration even if the annual return ultimately shows no Panamanian-source liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Unpaid quarterly installments accrue the 1.5% monthly surcharge plus a 10% delinquency surcharge at annual closing; non-filing of an installment declaration carries a fine of up to USD 500 per period and disqualification from tax clearance certificates for port and bunkering licensing renewals.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding on gross dividend distributions paid from profits taxed under the ordinary 25% ISR regime; 20% withholding applies to dividends paid from profits that benefitted from the Tasa Única (1% minimum tax) regime. Distributions funded exclusively by foreign-source (untaxed) earnings fall outside the Panamanian dividend WHT where the company can trace the profit pool with audited accounts.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: A non-resident shareholder seeking DTA relief must obtain an official Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the DGI for the income year, have the certificate apostilled, submit a treaty-relief request with a completed DGI beneficial-ownership declaration, and provide the paying Panamanian S.A. with the original or certified copy before the dividend payment date. The withholding agent retains the TRC as the precondition for applying the reduced treaty rate at source; if WHT was over-withheld, the shareholder may claim a refund through the DGI international affairs procedure within the statutory limitation window. Panama's DTA network (including treaties with Mexico, Singapore, South Korea, Luxembourg, the UAE, and other in-force agreements) generally caps dividends at 5%-10% for substantial shareholdings, subject to OECD-compliant limitation-on-benefits and substance certification.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Interest paid to non-resident lenders is generally outside Panamanian WHT where the credit is negotiated and economically used abroad; however, interest economically linked to Panamanian-source operations is taxable at source at the general 25% corporate rate if not removed by an applicable DTA (treaty ceilings commonly 5%-10%). Royalties, licensing fees, and technical-assistance payments for IP used in Panama are subject to statutory 12.5% WHT; a Panamanian bunker-brand licensee paying trademark or fuel-technology royalties to a foreign affiliate must substantiate arm's length value, while treaty relief (typically 10%) requires TRC-backed documentation and beneficial-ownership proof.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: USD 250,000 - annual aggregate related-party transactions exceeding this threshold trigger the mandatory transfer-pricing documentation and informative disclosure attached to Form 101 (Executive Decree 38 of 2018). A full Local File and Master File (functional analysis, comparability and benchmarking study) are required when aggregate controlled transactions exceed USD 2,000,000; group-wide Country-by-Country reporting applies to multinational groups with consolidated revenue of at least USD 750,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: ECONOMIC SUBSTANCE REQUIREMENTS (ESR) APPLY. Law 254 of 2021 imposes mandatory economic presence for Panamanian entities undertaking relevant activities, which expressly include international shipping-related operations, fuel distribution, and treasury/financing functions. A ship-bunkering S.A. must demonstrate Panamanian management and control (board meetings and strategic decisions in Panama), a local registered office and physical premises, qualified local employees sufficient to execute the core revenue-generating activities, and local operating expenditure proportionate to the profit booked. An annual Relevance Activity Declaration and ESR return must be filed with the DGI by the statutory tax-return deadline. Foreign-source exemption does not waive ESR; failure to satisfy substance results in loss of tax-residence benefits, treaty denial, and sanction under the ESR penalty ladder.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately omitting bunker sales invoices from Form 101, fabricating offshore costs to reduce Panamanian-source profits, or mischaracterizing domestic port-fuel sales as foreign-source income to exploit the territorial exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal tax evasion penalties: fines from 100% to 300% of the evaded tax, monthly surcharges of 1.5% on unpaid amounts, and imprisonment of two to five years under the Código Fiscal and Código Penal; DGI may seize bank accounts, vessels, and receivables and cancel operating licenses.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers who direct or knowingly tolerate the false declaration are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of the evaded tax; the corporate veil is pierced, personal travel bans are imposed, and conviction carries imprisonment of up to five years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlawful Dividend Distribution and WHT Avoidance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Paying dividends, shareholder advances, or disguised profit distributions without applying the 10% or 20% Panama dividend WHT, or labeling distributions as foreign-source without audited profit-pool tracing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI assesses the unwithheld tax against the S.A. plus a 100% surcharge under Article 712 of the Código Fiscal, mora interest at 1.5% per month, and denial of future tax clearance; repeated violations trigger criminal prosecution of the company's authorized signatories.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Board members who approve unlawful distributions are personally liable for the unrecovered WHT and interest; they face civil enforcement against personal assets, exit bans, and criminal indictment for fraudulent profit partition.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Sham Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a nominee-only S.A. with no physical office, no local employees, and no Panamanian management while booking bunkering profits as foreign-source, or using the entity solely to hold accounts and funnel fuel payments through offshore affiliates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Panama's Economic Substance Law 254 of 2021 imposes progressive fines up to USD 100,000 for false substance declarations, nullification of the entity's tax-residence certificate, DGI recharacterization of all foreign-source revenue as Panamanian-source, and potential dissolution of the S.A.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Nominee and de facto directors face joint financial liability for the recharacterized tax, disqualification from holding directorships, travel restrictions pending payment, and criminal money-laundering charges where the sham entity was used to conceal ownership.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Money Laundering and AML Compliance Failure in Bunkering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting cash or unexplained third-party wire payments for marine fuel, issuing split or false invoices, transacting with sanctioned vessels/entities, or using layered Panamanian S.A. accounts for refueling receivables without client due diligence, while failing to file suspicious-transaction reports under Law 23 of 2015.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: AML fines up to USD 1,000,000 per violation against the S.A. and its compliance officer; criminal money-laundering conviction carries imprisonment of five to twelve years, forfeiture of vessels and fuel cargo, and administrative closure of the bunkering license by the maritime authority.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, beneficial owners, and compliance officers are criminally liable for organized money-laundering acts; asset forfeiture without prior conviction is possible, combined with Interpol red notices, travel bans, and the collapse of corporate limited-liability protection for gross negligence.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Documentation Failure and Mispricing
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to prepare and attach the required TP study when related-party transactions exceed the USD 250,000 threshold, or pricing bunker product transfers, brand royalties, or financing below arm's length to shift Panama-source profit into tax-haven affiliates.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: DGI TP adjustment recharacterizing the transaction, a 10% penalty on the resulting underpayment, fixed fines up to USD 10,000 for omitted documentation per Executive Decree 38 of 2018, loss of treaty benefits, and audit extension to the previous three fiscal years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Responsible directors face civil restitution for the adjusted tax and penalty amounts; intentional TP mispricing is prosecuted as fraud, exposing signatories to travel bans, personal asset execution, and criminal imprisonment.
